content_sections.text: 03 years of relevant experience in handling Procurement/ Stores/ Accounts-related work in Government organizations. Master of Business Administration from a Govt. recognized University or Institute.

content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal at https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in . Submit the online application latest by 15-10-2026. Provide details of 10th or equivalent, 12th or equivalent, graduation, and post-graduation qualification (if any). Ensure all information is complete, as incomplete information shall be summarily rejected. Submit the application online on behalf of the Outsource Agency for wider reach.

content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Administrative Assistant Important Instructions
content_sections.text: This is purely a temporary engagement, and selection does not entitle any claim whatsoever for regularization against any regular post or any vacancy arising in future or any cadre/post at IIT Jammu. The Outsource Agency will depute the selected candidate at IIT Jammu on an outsource basis. Good knowledge of computer applications and OS like MS-Windows is a must. Candidates must bring all original documents for verification during the Trade Test/Interaction. Candidates must provide details of 10th, 12th, graduation, and post-graduation qualifications.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment being conducted for?
faq.answer: The Outsource Agency has invited applications for the position of Administrative Assistant to work at IIT Jammu on an outsource basis under advertisement number HR - 78.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 02 vacancies available for the Administrative Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 15-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates in any discipline from a Govt. recognized University or Institute with at least 60% marks in aggregate or equivalent grade, along with good knowledge of computer applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for the Administrative Assistant position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary package is ₹27,000 – ₹35,700 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to submit online applications by visiting the official link at https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job at IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: No, this is purely a temporary engagement for an initial period of one year, and selection does not entitle any claim for regularization against any regular post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted for a Trade Test/Interaction evaluation, and must bring all original documents for verification.
